edits.value_json: 火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. 字源 tentatively glosses the oracle-bone occurrence as 火星 without specifying 心宿二; the CUHK 火 and 晶 entries interpret 火星 here as the historical short name for 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares). The sources do not establish why the star was called 火 or a semantic connection with literal ‘fire’.

The star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. 字源 tentatively glosses the oracle-bone occurrence as 火星 without specifying 心宿二; the CUHK 火 and 晶 entries interpret 火星 here as the historical short name for 大火, or 心宿二 (Antares). The sources do not establish why the star was called 火 or a semantic connection with literal ‘fire’.
